established_contexts.name: paved_road_other_vehicle_stop
established_contexts.source: frozen C179480 catalog layout, maneuver and control

variable_parameters.name: roadway_stop_placement
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: Surveyed travel-lane or shoulder stop target; actual roadway footprint measured.

variable_parameters.name: other_vehicle_hazard
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: Frozen other-vehicle control, with observed hazard presence or absence.

variable_parameters.name: governing_stop_control
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: Source-verified governing legal stop context; compatibility with C179480 unresolved.

variable_parameters.name: ego_stop_controller
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: Requested stop trajectory; actual completion measured from Native pose and speed.

variable_parameters.name: following_vehicle_controller
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: Fixed following actor route and response policy across roadway-stop comparison.

variable_parameters.name: following_gap_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: 7 to 12 m engineering brake-gap setpoint in a source-shaped CPU probe; actual minimum follower gap measured separately from raw Native frames.

variable_parameters.name: hazard_center_gap_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: 6 to 10 m source-shaped diagnostic hazard placement; actual ego-to-hazard minimum separation measured separately from original Native actor rows.

variable_parameters.name: governing_red_onset_s
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: 9 to 13 s synthetic control-phase setpoint at 20 Hz; observed red transition, ego association, legal applicability and actual Native realization remain separate source questions.
